Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

• Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact

• Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders

• Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape

• Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise

• Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

• Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment

• Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations

• Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities

• Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly

• Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights

• Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps

• Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions

• Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search

• Embrace our core values:

• 

• Give a Sh!t

• Always Be in It To Win It

• Be Obsessed with Serving Others

• Practice a Growth Mindset

• When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

• Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals

• Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations

• Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions

• Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations

• Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps

• Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

• Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients

• Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders

• Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence

• Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask

• Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines

• Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

• Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization

• Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance

• Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels

• Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights

• Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies

• Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

• 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS

• Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution

• Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients

• Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention

• Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement

• Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates

• Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities

• Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

• You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations

• You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations

• You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions

• Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations

• You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

• Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation

• Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses

• 5 weeks of paid time off

• Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones

• Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents

• Regular team meetups and annual retreats

• Clear career progression path without requiring a management track

• Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies

• Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers

• Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

• Working with top 1% SaaS experts

• Supportive and empathetic leadership

• End-to-end control with no account manager involvement

• Highly data-driven and results-oriented

• Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours

• Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

• Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers

• Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks

• Regular professional development opportunities

• Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies

• Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

Build governance, privacy, quality, lineage, cataloging, retention, and access management into the platform by design. We're looking for candidates with strong experience in modern data engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in building and managing end-to-end data pipelines, data transformation using dbt, and working with Google BigQuery and Apache Airflow. Experience in data warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema design, and Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) data domains is preferred.

• Design, build, orchestrate, and manage end-to-end data pipelines.
• Develop scalable and maintainable data transformation workflows using dbt.
• Participate in the full software and data development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
• Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across data platforms.
• Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following engineering best practices.
• Work with structured and semi-structured data sources to support analytics and reporting needs.
• Troubleshoot and optimize existing data pipelines and workflows.
• Develop, test, and maintain high-quality software and data engineering solutions using Python.

• BE/BTech/MCA with 3 to 5 years of relevant industry experience.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

• 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering.
• Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling.
• Experience in building and managing end-to-end data pipelines.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and Google BigQuery.
• Experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
• Strong understanding of Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT, and Star/Snowflake schema design.
• Proficiency in Python for data engineering and automation.
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

5bd6e8a803e82877.description: Middle Office Data Engineering and Quality We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Middle Office Data Engineering and Quality Professional to lead the build and evolve a best-in-class Data Quality and Engineering function in India. This role sits within the Public Markets Middle Office and is pivotal to ensuring data accuracy, transparency, and operational readiness across the firm's transaction lifecycle in support of clients, investment teams and traders, and other essential uses of this data. The successful candidate will be an innovative data science professional, who will develop quality control checks and insights to mitigate data quality issues, identify anomalies in data for research, and continuously improve upon the process to expand across a complex data set. This position will partner closely with the Middle Office functional teams to establish and evolve the cross-platform data quality framework and controls for transaction lifecycle data to support efficient trade processing. In the Operations division, we partner with business units across the Firm to support financial transactions, devise and implement effective controls and develop client relationships. This is a Team Supervisor position at Director level within the within Core Services, which is responsible for performing and managing product-agnostic and centralized operational services across several businesses and products What you'll do in the role: - Own and operationalize the Data Quality Framework for cross-platform transaction lifecycle data, ensuring strong governance, control coverage, and alignment with enterprise data strategy. - Design and deliver MI reporting and KPI dashboards (Power BI) to provide actionable insights on data health, operational performance, and key risk indicators to senior stakeholders. - Develop and implement scalable data quality controls across the transaction lifecycle, ensuring completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of data. - Establish robust data validation and exception monitoring processes, enabling proactive identification, tracking, and resolution of data quality issues. - Lead cross-platform alignment for integrated controls and monitoring, working closely with Middle Office, Technology, and Data Governance teams to ensure consistency in data outcomes. - Drive deep-dive analysis and root cause investigation of data exceptions, enabling scalable remediation, issue prevention, and structured escalation. - Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements and use cases, translating them into data-driven reporting solutions, dashboards, and automated control frameworks. - Build and optimize reporting and analytics layers using Power BI, SQL, and supporting tools to enhance transparency, decision-making, and operational efficiency. - Support change management, UAT, and implementation activities for data and reporting initiatives, ensuring seamless adoption and minimal operational disruption. - Deliver high-impact reporting outputs, including KPI dashboards, trend analysis, and exception reporting to senior management and data governance forums. - Ensure high-quality data outcomes for clients, investment teams, and downstream consumers, reinforcing trust in Middle Office data and enabling effective trade lifecycle management. What you'll bring to the role: - 68 years of experience in Investment Operations, Data Management, or Middle Office data & analytics within a global asset manager or financial services firm. - Robust proficiency in Power BI (dashboard design & development) with ability to deliver impactful MI reporting, KPI tracking, and data visualization (certification preferred). - Hands-on experience with SQL and Alteryx Designer for data transformation, workflow automation, and advanced analytics. - Strong understanding of data quality principles, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness, with hands-on experience in implementing these across complex datasets. - Proven expertise in data validation, data cleansing, and data governance frameworks, ensuring high-quality and reliable data for downstream consumption. - Solid understanding of the investment and trade lifecycle, including cross-platform data sets such as reference data, trades, prices, corporate actions, accruals, and amortization. - Experience working across diverse asset classes (equities, fixed income, derivatives, loans) and investment structures (pooled vehicles, SMAs, institutional mandates). - Experience with data quality and exception management platforms (e.g., PanDQ, Informatica, PEGA), including real-time validation, monitoring, and issue handling. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to perform root cause analysis, data lineage tracing, and exception trend analysis. - Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, supporting KPI reporting, operational optimization, and decision-making. - Exposure to data-driven .
